prompt: Composition: One dominant feature with smaller supporting entries, staggered hierarchy, linear mobile reading order. Build for this brief: An independent publication; readers discover stories and read long articles. Set headings in Archivo and reading text in Inter; grotesque heading with neutral interface text. Use Cobalt and Chalk: page #FFFFFF, text #132349, accent #164AC6, secondary surface #E8EFFC, text on accent #FFFFFF. Use body 18px, heading 28px, line height 1.75, reading measure at most 56ch, gap 8px, content width at most 1280px and item radius 4px. Keep letter spacing zero. At 390px use a single reading order, preserve required text and provide access to every control. Use real subject imagery when needed, not ornamental blobs. Check rendered text contrast and overflow; never call this recipe proven beautiful.
